verdict.rationale: Scribe is an API-first service that runs without any UI. It offers a synchronous REST transcription endpoint, a fully programmatic batch-job lifecycle (submit, status, list, cancel, per-file results, with explicit states and partial-failure handling), and signed outbound webhooks on job completion. Unattended automation is also supported by API credentials with scopes, expiration and IP allowlists, plus a published OpenAPI spec. Missing for 10: an official CLI, documented CI/pipeline integration examples, and independent or hands-on corroboration of headless automation use.
